messages:
emma: Quick heads-up: dry-run of internal announce for v2.20.0. Canary scheduled 07:30 UTC tomorrow, quiet window 07:15-09:00 UTC. Draft of release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.20.0-draft. Please flag anything customer-facing.

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.20.0-rc --targets=canary-6 --timeout=20m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.20.0-rc -> canary-6 (6 hosts). Watching p95, p99, 5xx, memory.

odds-oncall: (ops) Proposed pin: Dedicated fleets will be pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-04-15 during GA. Unpin timeline: target 7-14 days post-GA; SEs can request earlier unpin for customers with trades. Add note in release notes.

dennis: Added compatibility blurb about streaming API minor behavior change under "Behavior changes"; non-actionable.

hana: small legal check: privacy/telemetry line needs exact phrasing. Legal can approve within 6 hours.

legal: Suggested line: "Telemetry collected is limited to performance metrics and request metadata; customer payloads are not stored beyond retention policy." Approve if included exactly.

emma: adding legal's sentence verbatim. Also drafting a short "Pinning policy" bullet: "We pin runtime during GA to reduce variance; expected unpin 7-14 days after GA; contact your SE for exceptions."

support-lead: Support wants two canned replies pasted into notes:
- "Why is my runtime pinned?" -> "Pinned to reduce variability during the initial GA window; we will unpin customers after stability is confirmed."
- "Will my latency change?" -> "You may observe small tail changes; include request-id and timeframe if you file a ticket."

ops-oncall: Rollback thresholds proposal for this release: auto-rollback if 5xx >= 0.13% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency +30% sustained for 10m. Manual rollback requires release owner + oncall signoff. I'll be monitoring 07:00-09:30 UTC (PD_Rollout).

deploybot: Canary health snapshot @10m: p95 +3%, p99 +7%, 5xx 0.02%. No auto-rollback.

emma: suggestion: include a short "Rollback dry-run" step in the preflight checklist (confirm permissions and run rollback command in staging). Dennis can run tomorrow at 05:30 UTC.

dennis: I'll run the dry-run and paste results here once complete.

hana: legal signed off on the telemetry line. Public announce can proceed once we finish the dry-run and confirm metrics.

emma: final internal announce draft (will post to #eng-releases at 07:10 UTC):
"Internal: staged rollout v2.20.0 beginning with canary at 07:30 UTC. Quiet window 07:15-09:00 UTC. Key notes: Dedicated runtime pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-04-15 during GA (unpin ~7-14d post-GA); minor streaming API behavior change (compatibility note added); telemetry phrasing approved by legal. Rollback criteria & runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.20-rollout. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Rollout). Support copy included in notes. Public announce queued pending dry-run results. Questions in this thread."

ops-oncall: LGTM. I'll call for rollback immediately if thresholds exceed.

dennis: Dry-run complete: rollback command executed in staging and permissions verified. Pasted small snippet: `rollback v2.20.0 -> v2.19.x` success.

emma: great, posting internal announce now and queuing public announce for 08:45 UTC. Thanks everyone :rocket:

deploybot: /announce internal "v2.20.0 staged rollout - canary healthy, promoting to staged; public announce queued" --channel=#eng-releases --when=7101235100

emma: bot queued. Closing this dry-run thread; monitoring continues in the runbook.
